_doc: Exit targets per phase of docs/SPEC_GAP_ANALYSIS.md. A stage is ready when `python -m tools.gate --phase <id>` passes: unit tests, JavaScript syntax, no regression against baseline.json, and these targets. Ratios are 0..1.

0._doc: Foundations: vendored spec artifacts, metric runner, baseline recorded.

1._doc: KerML/SysML abstract syntax: every metaclass exists with the spec's supertypes and owned (non-derived) properties; relationships are first-class.

2a._doc: Full textual notation to AST: every library and example file parses with no diagnostics, within the time budget.

2b._doc: AST to model, standard libraries loaded by parsing, printer round trip.

3._doc: Semantics: implied relationships and spec validation constraints with no false errors on the corpus.
